name: Scholar Watching the Waterfall
material: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: In this hanging scroll, a scholar and his attendant contemplate a waterfall. A light breeze lifts the scholar’s robe and blows the tree leaves, suggesting movement.
